from pathlib import Path
import sqlite3
sql = '''WITH genre_sales AS (
    SELECT
        i.BillingCountry AS country,
        t.GenreId AS genre_id,
        g.Name AS genre,
        SUM(CAST(ROUND(il.UnitPrice * 100, 0) AS INTEGER) * il.Quantity) AS revenue_cents,
        SUM(il.Quantity) AS units
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il
      ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Track AS t
      ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId
    JOIN Genre AS g
      ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
    WHERE i.InvoiceDate >= '2021-01-01'
      AND i.InvoiceDate < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY i.BillingCountry, t.GenreId, g.Name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        genre_id,
        genre,
        revenue_cents,
        units,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, genre_id ASC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM genre_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    genre_id,
    genre,
    revenue_cents,
    units,
    country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country ASC, country_rank ASC;
'''
Path('/work/query.sql').write_text(sql, encoding='utf-8')

p='/inputs/Chinook.sqlite'
con=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
steps=[0]
def progress():
    steps[0]+=100
    if steps[0] > 2_000_000: return 1
    return 0
con.set_progress_handler(progress,100)
cur=con.execute(sql)
print('columns:', [d[0] for d in cur.description])
rows=cur.fetchall()
print('rows:',len(rows),'approx vm steps:',steps[0])
for r in rows[:12]: print(r, tuple(type(x).__name__ for x in r))
print('last:', rows[-3:])
# Check ranking and maximum rows per country.
from collections import Counter
counts=Counter(r[0] for r in rows)
assert max(counts.values(), default=0) <= 2
assert all([d[0] for d in con.execute(sql).description][i] == n for i,n in enumerate(['country','genre_id','genre','revenue_cents','units','country_rank']))
assert Path('/work/query.sql').read_text() == sql
print('sql bytes:',len(sql.encode()),'max countries:',max(counts.values(),default=0))
con.close()
